title: Quarterly crosswalk: decision protocol for Hosted API & Model Catalog alignment
creator: Omar Reyes
description:
Problem: Quarterly planning for the Hosted API product and the Model Catalog teams has drifted into parallel workstreams. Decisions about which model variants to promote to Hosted tiers, deprecation windows, and canary schedules are being made in separate forums, causing rework, missed capacity hedges, and customer confusion.

Goal: Define and operationalize a lightweight crosswalk decision protocol that pairs a PM-level cadence with engineering readiness signals so that Hosted API releases and Model Catalog promotions are synchronized, observable, and rollbackable. The protocol should be lightweight enough to run each quarter without blocking delivery and produce a single canonical deliverable: a Joint Quarterly Commitment memo plus an automated gating checklist that feeds the release cadence.

Scope: Hosted API endpoints, the curated Model Catalog (hosted variants), canary windows, and circuit-breaker fallback policies. Does not include Dedicated capacity reservation contracts (out of scope for this ticket).

Non-goals: Re-architecting rollout or autoscaling mechanisms (eng will surface blockers), policy changes to pricing, or establishing new SLAs in this ticket — those will be follow-ups if protocol identifies gaps.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable meeting cadence and owner roster is documented (PM + Eng + RD + Support) for quarterly decisions
A one-page Joint Quarterly Commitment memo template exists and is stored in Confluence linked from this ticket
An automated gating checklist (GitHub Actions / dashboard signal mapping) with clear pass/fail criteria is defined and reviewed by Eng
A rollback/playbook stub for model substitutions during canaries is drafted and validated with on-call SRE
Stakeholder sign-off (Product lead + Eng manager + SRE) captured in comments before due_date
tasks: Draft proposed crosswalk agenda and owner roles (PM owner, model steward, infra rep, SRE, analytics)
Map model promotion criteria to operational signals (latency, error rate, cost per token, regen rate)
Design Joint Quarterly Commitment memo template and example for Q2 with sample commitments
Prototype gating checklist as a simple JSON schema and a GitHub Action that verifies required dashboard signals
Run one dry-run tabletop with stakeholders and capture gaps and action items
